question: The word 'Green' in Green Revolution refers to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Crops**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The main objective of the Green Revolution was to increase agricultural production, especially in food crops.
 
• The word 'Green' signifies the greening of crops and development of the agricultural sector.
 
• This revolution started in India in the 1960s under the leadership of Norman Borlaug.
 
• The Green Revolution drastically increased the production of wheat and rice in India.
 
• It helped make India self-sufficient in food grain production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Components of Green Revolution​:**

 
 
• Improved seeds: Use of high productivity hybrid seeds.
 
• Chemical fertilizers: Extensive use of fertilizers to increase crop production.
 
• Irrigation: Improvement in irrigation facilities and efficient use of water.
 
• Mechanization: Use of agricultural implements and tractors.
 
 
 
• Norman Borlaug: Considered the father of the Green Revolution, who contributed to the development of improved varieties.
 
• Effects of the Green Revolution:
 
 
• Increase in food grain production.
 
• Reduction in poverty and hunger.
 
• Economic improvement in the agricultural sector.
 
 
 
• Challenges**:**
 
 
• Decline in soil fertility.
 
• Excessive water consumption and water crisis.
 
• Ignoring small farmers.
